description: You step onto a shifting floor. A huge glass sign reads: 'Every step is different.' Ahead, you can hear the sound of lapping waves.

void_wall.description: A shimmering wall of pure static that hurts to look at.

stone_floor.description: A rubbery floor that bends perception.

exit_east.description: Back east to the Forgotten Forest.

exit_west.description: A wooden fishing dock with multiple boats. A particular wooden boat has the names 'Fred, Freddista & Willy' freshly carved into its side. Leap on to board!

shift_tile_arcade.description: 👾 ZIP! The entire area changes! The trees turn into retro 8-bit sprites, and the sky becomes a dark arcade cabinet screen with neon high-score indicators!

shift_tile_metal.description: ⚙️ CLANK! The environment shifts again! The pixelated trees turn into giant rotating steel gears, and the ground changes into heavy metallic plates.

shift_tile_acid.effectMessage: The bubbling green acid burns your sole!
shift_tile_acid.description: 🧪 WARP! The ground under your sole turns into a glowing green pool of bubbling acid! (If you have Expectant Float, you float safely above the corrosion!)

fishing_spot.description: A wooden railing looking over the deep, lapping ocean. It looks like a perfect fishing spot!
fishing_spot.onInteract: You cast a line over the railing and wait... YANK! You pull up a soggy, miserable wet sock! The sock sighs: 'Great, now I'm out of the water and still single. Life is a tragedy.' You gently drop the complaining sock back into the ocean.
